title: The Quest page jumps on slow phones (CLS 0.301) and image-led public pages take over 4 s to paint

source.ref: SCAN-1218 production field measurement 2026-11-16, e2e-manual run 43938516828

detail:
EVIDENCE (production, clean profile, phone 390 with 1.6 Mbps, 150 ms latency and 4x CPU, median of 3 cold loads): /the-quest CLS 0.301 (poor; 0 unthrottled at 390, 0.047 at 1280), LCP 5.3 s on an img. LCP over 4 s also on /pricing 5.6 s (a background-image div), /about 4.6 s, /the-community 4.5 s, /discover 4.4 s, /spaces 3.9 s; every one has an image as its LCP element, while the h1-led pages paint in 1.6 to 2.3 s. / blocks the main thread for 3.8 s (longest task 825 ms) where the other pages stay under 1.7 s on the same script bytes. WHY IT MATTERS: these are the launch landing pages and North County visitors arrive on phones. FIX DIRECTION: find what shifts /the-quest late on a slow link (an image or block without reserved size); give the hero image on each image-led page a preload or fetchpriority and a right-sized source; profile the home page's long task. Then re-run e2e-manual against production and replace the tables in docs/perf/public-cwv-baseline.md.

2026-11-16 PROGRESS (production re-measure, e2e-manual run 43957433438, after #5102): /the-quest throttled-phone CLS 0.301 to 0 (desktop 0.047 to 0.002), the pre-paint open of the linked panel. /pricing throttled-phone LCP 5628 to 3324 ms, the hero preload (preview control 6112 to 3216 ms, runs 43945613879 and 43946107687). #5123 carries the same preload to /spaces and the Discover hero. STILL OPEN: /the-quest throttled LCP 5200 ms (an image below the anchor), /about 4.6 s, /the-community 4.4 s, /discover 4.3 s, /spaces 3.9 s, and the home page main-thread blocking (3.6 s on a throttled phone). Probe still fails on the Quest LCP, correctly. RE-MEASURE 2026-11-16 23:21 UTC (e2e-manual run 43978441871, production bc1e6aa0, after #5123, #5134, #5136), throttled-phone LCP: /spaces 3.9 to 2.3 s and /discover 4.3 to 2.9 s (the #5123 hero preloads); /the-community 4.4 to 3.5 s (#5136); /the-quest 5.2 to 5.0 s, so the probe still fails (CLS holds at 0). #5134 starts the Quest photo request when the inline script runs, but that script sits after both half sections, so on a 1.6 Mbps link the parser reaches it late. Next for the Quest: start the request from the top of the page (a head-side hint keyed on the hash), or make the anchored job photo lighter. /about fell 4.6 to 2.0 s with no change aimed at it; unexplained until repeated. Home page main-thread blocking is 4.4 s on this run (3.6 s before) and is the other open half. RE-MEASURE 2026-11-17 04:25 UTC (e2e-manual run 44017021840, production 5c91495a or later, after #5146, #5149, #5150, #5151, #5152, #5153), throttled phone: blocking /pricing 3.9 to 1.3 s, /the-community 2.7 to 1.0 s, / 4.4 to 3.3 s; LCP /pricing 3.8 to 2.8 s, /the-community 3.5 to 2.8 s, /discover 2.9 to 2.0 s; /the-quest 5.0 to 4.7 s, so the probe still fails, correctly. The Quest photo is bandwidth-bound (photo bytes against about 560 KB of script at 1.6 Mbps), not discovery-bound. Still open: the Quest LCP and the home page's 3.3 s of blocking (mostly React startup).

verify.note: Reads the /the-quest throttled-phone row of the production baseline: passes when a fresh production measurement shows CLS at or under 0.1 and LCP at or under 4 s.
